Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 3–7 Years
Department: AI & Machine Learning

Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer with expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLMs, and RAG architectures, complemented by a solid foundation in traditional machine learning. You will build, evaluate, and deploy production-grade AI solutions with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and code quality.

• Design and develop Generative AI applications using LLMs, prompt engineering, and structured outputs.
• Build advanced RAG pipelines using embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, and vector databases.

• Develop and deploy enterprise level applications using Azure AI services.

• Build data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, and evaluation pipelines.
• Write clean, modular, testable, and maintainable Python code following software engineering best practices.
• Integrate AI solutions into production systems through APIs, with appropriate security, monitoring, and observability.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field.
• 4–7 years of experience in AI/ML development and software engineering.
• Strong Python programming skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn.
• Understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including classification, regression, model evaluation, and feature engineering.
• Hands-on experience with LLMs, Generative AI, RAG, embeddings, and vector databases.
• Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent LLM orchestration frameworks.
• Understanding of AI agents, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and failure handling.
• Familiarity with evaluation frameworks such as RAGAS, DeepEval, or equivalent tools.
• Experience with APIs, automated testing, Git, CI/CD, databases, and cloud deployments.

• Knowledge of LLM fine-tuning, LoRA/PEFT, and model optimization.

• Exposure to computer vision, multimodal AI, and MLOps/LLMOps practices.

Director, Enterprise Applications

Position Profile

Function: Business Technology — Enterprise Applications

Reporting line: Chief Security and Business Technology Officer

Role Purpose

Lead the strategy, delivery and continuous improvement of 6sense’s enterprise applications, turning business priorities into secure, scalable platforms and measurable outcomes. This is a business transformation leadership role—not simply an application administration or project delivery role.

The Director will partner with Go-to-Market, Customer Success, Support, Finance, Legal and Partner Operations to simplify processes, strengthen data quality and controls, and improve how work gets done. AI fluency and applied AI delivery are core requirements: the role must identify where AI creates value, where conventional automation is better, and where human judgment must remain accountable.

Responsibilities & Accountabilities

1. Enterprise Strategy & Business Partnership

• Own a business-aligned application roadmap and investment portfolio, balancing growth, operational efficiency, risk, user experience and technical debt.

• Partner with functional leaders to define business problems, accountable process owners, funding, expected benefits and adoption commitments before delivery begins.

• Run transparent prioritization and portfolio reviews; challenge low-value requests and communicate trade-offs, dependencies and decisions clearly.

2. AI-Enabled Business Transformation

• Build a prioritized portfolio of AI and automation opportunities across business workflows, starting with process redesign and data readiness rather than tool selection.

• Lead build-versus-buy-versus-configure decisions with Enterprise AI Engineering, application owners, Security, Legal and Finance.

• Set standards for discovery, prototypes, evaluation, user acceptance testing, rollout and value realization. Require evidence before moving pilots into production.

• Own application budgets, license utilization, vendor performance and total cost of ownership; consider AI usage costs as well as subscription and integration costs.

Joining Collibra's Marketing Team

At Collibra, we believe the next decade of enterprise value will be decided by whether AI can be trusted to act. Agents are moving from demos to decisions, and the leaders deploying them need certainty at the speed of AI. It's why we built the Enterprise AI Control Plane, over eighteen years of ontology engineering, to govern context and ensure control across any data, any model, any agent. We are builders who come from a wide range of backgrounds to do what has never been done before.

About this role

We are looking for a VP, Product Marketing & Executive Thought Leadership to own the narrative for Collibra's business, and to lead the team that takes it to market. This is a category-defining role at a defining moment: the vocabulary of AI context is being written right now, and we intend to author it.

You will make our CEO the recognized voice of the category, on every stage and in every byline that matters. You will build the joint story with the platforms the world runs AI on — Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud, SAP. And you will grow and coach a team of product marketers into a multi-layer org that ships market-moving launches without you in the room. You manage managers: directors own the day-to-day launches; you own the bar, the narrative, and the few things that cannot be delegated. This is a 0→1 category role inside an 18-year-old company — you'll define how a new market is positioned, messaged, and brought to the world.

About you

You are a builder of leaders, not a soloist. You've run a PMM org through managers and you know the difference between setting a standard and taking back the pen — you coach the launch from spec-sheet to stake, and you let your directors own it. You move fluently between a whiteboard with engineers and a green room with a CEO, translating architecture into a story technical and business leaders both lean toward. You've moved a category before, ideally from the challenger's seat, not the incumbent's. You have a passion for proof — every number you ship traces to a source — and an unapologetic focus on customer truth over internal belief. You thrive where the assets are good but the narrative and the discipline are the gap, and you'd rather open a new frontier than chase a competitor into theirs.

About Collibra

Collibra is building the Enterprise AI Control Plane — the layer that governs context and ensures control so enterprises can deploy AI with certainty. Eighteen years of ontology and semantic engineering sit underneath it. We are at the center of the most important shift in enterprise software: the move from data governance to governing the context and agents that act on it. We are an entrepreneurial company with a founder who wants to be the author of this category, and a marketing team rebuilding around the AI growth motion to make that real.

• Build and lead the team. Hire, develop, and coach director-level PMM leaders and their teams. Create an environment where strong people do their best work, raise the bar with every hire, and build a bench that ships launch-quality narrative without you in the room.

Set the storytelling standard across the funnel, first-call decks, demo scripts, solution maps, campaign briefs, customer proof, playbooks, so the field carries a story buyers move on, not a feature list. Measured by what closes, not what ships.
